inlines.v: SUP'PLICATE, verb transitive [Latin supplico; sub and plico. See Suppliant.] 1. To entreat for; to seek by earnest prayer; as, to supplicate blessings on christian efforts to spread the gospel. 2. To address in prayer; as, to supplicate the throne of grace. SUP'PLICATE, verb intransitive To entreat; to beseech; to implore; to petition with earnestness and submission. A man cannot brook to supplicate or beg.
